Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

anatembea 1.1.0

  • Added opt-in pMCMC output modes that reduce runtime and memory use when full state trajectories are not required. Existing calls retain the previous full-output behaviour by default; use output_level = "minimal", save_state = FALSE, and save_trajectories = FALSE for the smallest output.
  • Bounded fitted log_init_EIR proposals and corrected their prior specification, improving the reliability of initial = "fitted" runs.
  • Added staged articles for preparing data and configuration, tuning pMCMC, and assessing confirmation and production chains.
  • Added user controls for ODE absolute tolerance, relative tolerance, and the maximum number of ODE steps.

anatembea 1.0 (accepted manuscript freeze)

  • Frozen reproducibility point for the accepted ANC pMCMC manuscript, published in The Lancet Microbe.
  • Published article: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2666524726000704.
  • Associated preservation tag: v1.0-paper.
  • Intended manuscript runtime context: R 4.4 with odin 1.5.11, dust 0.15.3, and mcstate 0.9.22.
  • Analysis repository: https://github.com/jt-hicks/anc_pmcmc_pub.
